scalp_learning.json.purpose: Profit-linked scalp statistics and promotion evidence.

committee_history.json.purpose: Historical Investment Committee decisions and evidence snapshots.

committee_learning.json.purpose: Outcome-linked evidence on which committee conditions improve or damage portfolio results.

trade_reviews.json.purpose: Concise post-trade case files, exit-quality reviews and re-entry surveillance.

learning_state.json.purpose: V12 evidence-based learning state: trade process, missed opportunities, rule candidates and promoted lessons.

trade_diagnostics.json.purpose: Structured diagnosis of winners, small losses, give-backs, entry timing and missed re-entry.

challenger_arena.json.purpose: Paper-only shadow strategy competition. No challenger may allocate real or main paper-wallet capital.

market_school.json.purpose: Historical chart-pattern evidence mined from every recorded tracked asset, including missed large moves.

intelligence_bus.json.purpose: Shared evidence bus connecting Observer, Committee, Risk, Diagnostics, Learning, Challengers and Portfolio Manager.

microstructure_latest.json.purpose: Latest 1m/5m execution-timing state with role-aware entry, exit/profit-protect, pullback and reversal signals.

microstructure_history.json.purpose: Historical 1m/5m states for peak, trough, pullback and reversal learning.

trade_coach.json.purpose: Cross-trade coaching, profit capture, missed re-entry and agent-accountability evidence.

confidence_ledger.json.purpose: Sample-gated calibration ledger for specialist analysts and decision components.

brain_health.json.purpose: Freshness and communication health of the connected intelligence system.

trade_integrity.json.purpose: Independent validation gate. Only trustworthy trade records may teach learning engines.

trade_quarantine.json.purpose: Trade records held out of learning because integrity checks require review.

winner_school.json.purpose: Repeatable fingerprints and lessons mined from validated profitable trades.

failure_school.json.purpose: Failure-mode fingerprints and lessons mined from validated losing or poorly managed trades.

profit_capture.json.purpose: Profit-capture, giveback and exit-management evidence for validated trades.

trade_dna.json.purpose: Categorical DNA records for validated trades used for historical analogue comparison.

peak_trough_intelligence.json.purpose: Peak, trough, pullback and reversal evidence mined from recorded trade replays and microstructure history.

pattern_miner.json.purpose: Sample-gated repeated trade-DNA patterns and candidate lessons.

management_challenger.json.purpose: Shadow-only exit/management policy comparison using recorded chronological replay paths.

committee_memory.json.purpose: Outcome-linked specialist accountability and advisory memory for the Investment Committee.

intelligence_feedback.json.purpose: Cross-learning summary shared upstream with Committee, Portfolio Manager and other connected engines.

ai_scorecard.json.purpose: Simple decision-quality scorecard covering integrity, capture, learning and agent evidence.

strategy_brain_status.json.purpose: Plain-English Strategy Lab control-centre synthesis of experiments, discoveries and connected brain progress.

active_trade_casefiles.json.purpose: Current per-trade operations case files joining position sizing, risk, profit protection, committee, learning and current mission.

active_trade_thought_history.json.purpose: Bounded chronological active-trade management thought records for later replay and learning.

time_intelligence.json.purpose: Trade timing evidence: entry/exit times, holding duration, time to MFE/MAE, profitable time, peak-to-exit delay and re-entry delay.

move_phase_intelligence.json.purpose: Live and historical move-phase classification: ignition, acceleration, trending, extension, exhaustion and reset/reversal.

learning_evidence_centre.json.purpose: Auditable evidence chain linking learning claims to supporting trades, counterexamples, sample gates and promotion status.

observer_audit.json.purpose: Verifies 5m/15m observer run frequency, expected vs analysed assets, data providers, run gaps and 24h coverage.

adaptive_attention.json.purpose: Ranks assets by observation priority so interesting markets receive deeper scrutiny without reducing baseline coverage.

external_attention.json.purpose: Structured news/social-attention evidence from configured feeds, CoinGecko trending and optional NewsAPI.

brain_audit.json.purpose: End-to-end audit of engines, inputs, outputs, freshness and whether downstream consumers received the evidence.

brain_receipts.json.purpose: Producer/consumer receipts proving that selected learning and external-intelligence outputs were actually read downstream.

strategy_integrity.json.purpose: Audits Strategy Lab trade returns and detects extreme/unbounded strategy simulations before they are treated as trustworthy evidence.

trade_reflections.json.purpose: Per-trade structured reflection: process quality, thesis failure clues, reverse-trade study, stop-loss value saved, lesson usefulness and promotion state.

missed_clues.json.purpose: Repeated missed-clue catalogue mined from completed trade reflections with supporting and counter-examples.

reverse_trade_lab.json.purpose: Shadow-only opposite-direction replay analysis used to study whether failed trades contained evidence for the reverse direction.

lesson_promotion_board.json.purpose: Sample-gated promotion board for reflection-derived lessons; no single trade can alter live decision rules.

market_truth.json.purpose: Canonical identity and price-integrity gate. QUARANTINE data cannot trade or teach.

market_truth_history.json.purpose: Last validated prices used for discontinuity detection.

stop_execution_alerts.json.purpose: P0 hard-stop breach events that execution must process before signal logic.

decision_truth_replay.json.purpose: Timestamp-forward grading of every Committee BUY/SHORT decision at multiple horizons.

major_move_forensics.json.purpose: Automatic forensic cases for large observed moves and their pre-move fingerprints.

learning_quarantine.json.purpose: Symbols/evidence blocked from learning because market truth is not validated.

learning_experience_store.json.purpose: Validated experiences separated deterministically into TRAIN, VALIDATION and HOLDOUT datasets.

learning_rewards.json.purpose: Multi-dimensional diagnostic rewards for direction, risk, stop compliance, entry, capture, holding, re-entry and data integrity.

counterfactual_lab.json.purpose: Post-trade shadow alternatives derived only from real recorded replay data.

adversarial_learning.json.purpose: Counter-evidence attack results for candidate lessons using train and validation data only.

learning_curriculum.json.purpose: Competency ladder that locks advanced autonomy until earlier skills are measurably reliable.

learning_governor.json.purpose: Formal learning gatekeeper; live policy auto-promotion is disabled.

heartbeat_5m.json.purpose: Independent completion heartbeat for the protected 5-minute market loop.

heartbeat_15m.json.purpose: Independent completion heartbeat for the 15-minute decision loop.

heartbeat_hourly.json.purpose: Independent completion heartbeat for the hourly intelligence loop.

heartbeat_nightly.json.purpose: Independent completion heartbeat for the nightly deep-learning loop.

runtime_watchdog.json.purpose: Lightweight freshness and wallet-to-Trading-Desk reconciliation watchdog.
